* '''Mission''': [[File:GTA San Andreas radar Sweet.png]][[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas/Beat Down on B Dup|Beat Down on B Dup]]
* '''Location''': [[File:GTA San Andreas radar Sweet.png]]Sweet's house, Los Santos
|}

This is essentially a [[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas/Turf Wars|Turf War]] with the addition of Sweet's dubious help. He seems as likely to be run down by passing cars as other gang members, ending the mission automatically.

To complete the mission you need to take two territories in Idlewood. The first is marked by the mission pointer and I think the easiest second territory is at the garage (gas station).

Once the mission is complete you need to conquer a third of the remaining territories to open up the final mission.

== Tips ==
When you quickly get in the car next to your home without Sweet and drive off alone to Idlewood, he won't follow you and the mission will be much easier without him getting killed around. Also try to pick up all health packs you can (the heart and body armour), this will help you a lot.

== Rewards ==
* '''Cash:''' $10,000
* Respect +
